source.title: Dopamine transients are sufficient and necessary for acquisition of model-based associations

confidence_rationale: Strong causal design (optogenetic sufficiency AND necessity, sensory preconditioning) reported in Nature Neuroscience, which makes the source quality high. It weakens MECH-034 because it shows the canonical value-coded signal is itself causally required for building the model of the world -- the exact confound the claim's falsifier names as 'one signal wearing two names'. Confidence held at 0.71 because dopamine is not a clean stand-in for REE residue: REE's residue is harm-keyed and non-erasable, dopamine transients here are driven by neutral stimulus-stimulus transitions with no reward at all.
failure_signatures: The value-coded transient is not confined to the value surface: suppressing dopamine across a neutral stimulus-stimulus transition PREVENTS model learning, so the two putative currencies share a causal channel rather than merely co-occurring.

If REE's residue write path were implemented on a shared error broadcast, a harm-only manipulation would raise the staleness surface as a side effect -- the off-diagonal failure MECH-034's falsifier pre-registers as refutation.
A dissociation established by anatomical read-out (Glascher et al. 2010) can survive alongside a shared causal driver; read-out separability is therefore not sufficient evidence for MECH-034.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Prediction errors underlying stimulus-stimulus (non-rewarded) learning can be blocked behaviourally and reinstated by optogenetically activating dopamine neurons, and suppressing those neurons across the transition prevents normal stimulus-stimulus learning; dopamine transients are therefore both sufficient and necessary for acquiring model-based associations, contrary to the value-only canon.
mapping.ree_translation: REE reads this as the strongest available counterweight to MECH-034. The neuromodulatory signal that REE's residue channel is architecturally analogous to turns out to be causally required for writing the world model -- the surface MECH-034 wants to keep separate. If the same holds in V3, a harm-only manipulation should contaminate the staleness surface and the claimed double dissociation collapses.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The analogy from dopamine to REE residue is loose and should not be over-drawn. Dopamine here is carrying a general associative error over NEUTRAL stimuli, with no reward and no harm anywhere in the preconditioning phase; REE residue is defined by harm and violation outcomes specifically. So the paper shows a value-CODED substrate doing model work, not a harm-coded one. It weakens MECH-034 by supplying a concrete mechanism for the co-variation failure mode, not by directly measuring it. Rodent optogenetics to a latent-geometry substrate is a long transfer.
mapping.source_context: Rats, sensory preconditioning with optogenetic activation and inhibition of VTA dopamine neurons; no primary reward present during the critical stimulus-stimulus phase.

confidence_components.notes: Two erratum notices are attached to this paper (2017, 2018); neither retracts the central optogenetic result, but they are noted here because the record should not present the paper as unamended. Mapping fidelity is the weak component: dopamine-as-residue is an architectural analogy REE has not itself committed to.
